title: Vanishing of the first cohomology of multiples of a relatively ample bundle on a flat proper family
author: The Stacks Project Authors
work: Stacks Project, chapter more-morphisms.tex (More on Morphisms)
source_version: Stacks Project source tree, file more-morphisms.tex, corpus local snapshot 20261011
difficulty_reason: Given a flat proper finitely presented family and a relatively ample invertible module, the proof establishes vanishing of the first cohomology of sufficiently high multiples after an arbitrary base change, together with the finite local freeness of the corresponding direct images. The argument must control the base change of the direct images under a flat proper morphism and then exploit relative ampleness to push the vanishing degree high enough. The uniform degree over all base changes is the load-bearing point. Retained author proof at lines 9543-9619.
